command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/workspace/omega_runtime
C=$ROOT/carrier_repo
BASE=9662238027581bfd390cd0ca3fd46480f28e1ba4
HEAD=a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b
DEPLOY_REF=origin/omega-vps-deploy
DEST=$ROOT/releases/$HEAD
STAGE=$ROOT/releases/.stage-$HEAD-777
git -C "$C" fetch --quiet origin omega-vps-deploy
if [ -e "$DEST" ]; then echo DEST_ALREADY_EXISTS; else
  test ! -e "$STAGE"
  mkdir -p "$STAGE"
  git -C "$C" archive "$DEPLOY_REF:omega_deploy/${BASE}-flat-v2" | tar -x -C "$STAGE"
  for f in nonblocking_relay.py spool_bridge_relay_parallel.py supervisor_outer.py unified_store.py; do
    git -C "$C" show "$DEPLOY_REF:omega_deploy/$HEAD/omega/$f" > "$STAGE/omega/$f"
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$HEAD" > "$STAGE/.OMEGA_SOURCE_HEAD"
fi
TARGET="$STAGE"; [ -d "$DEST" ] && TARGET="$DEST"
python3 - <<'PY' "$C" "$TARGET" "$DEPLOY_REF" "$HEAD"
import json,subprocess,sys,pathlib
c,t,ref,h=sys.argv[1:]; t=pathlib.Path(t)
d=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',c,'show',f'{ref}:omega_deploy/{h}/DELTA.json'],text=True))
assert d['source_head']==h and d['frozen_for_deployment'] is True
for path,want in d['files'].items():
 p=t/path
 if not p.exists():
  if path.startswith('tests/'):
   print('DELTA_TEST_NOT_CARRIED',path); continue
  raise SystemExit('MISSING_RUNTIME_DELTA:'+path)
 got=subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object',str(p)],text=True).strip(); print('BLOB',path,got); assert got==want,(path,got,want)
print('DELTA_RUNTIME_BINDING=PASS')
PY
PYTHONPATH="$TARGET" python3 -m compileall -q "$TARGET/omega"
cd "$TARGET"
PYTHONPATH="$TARGET" python3 -m pytest -q
PYTHONPATH="$TARGET" python3 - <<'PY'
import omega.nonblocking_relay, omega.spool_bridge_relay_parallel, omega.supervisor_outer, omega.unified_store
print('A676_IMPORT_SMOKE=PASS')
PY
if [ "$TARGET" = "$STAGE" ]; then mv "$STAGE" "$DEST"; fi
printf 'STAGED_RELEASE=%s\n' "$DEST"
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD=%s\n' "$(cat "$DEST/.OMEGA_SOURCE_HEAD")"
